description: Harden finish/approval gates so task completion carries durable proof: task id, changed files or explicit no-diff result, verification output, runtime/model/agent attribution where available, and reviewer/critic outcome.
acceptance: Finish evidence records task id, changed files or explicit no-diff result, and verification command/result.
Finish evidence records runtime/model/agent attribution where available without blocking mechanical tasks that lack model metadata.
Non-trivial tasks require reviewer/critic outcome or explicit skip reason before approval.
Regression coverage rejects finish/approval attempts with missing evidence fields.
